def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cells in comps(g):
        ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
        t,b,l,r=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        cols=[]
        while t<=b:
            c=g[t][l]; s=1
            while t+s<=b and g[t+s][l+s]==c and g[b-s][r-s]==c and g[t+s][r-s]==c and g[b-s][l+s]==c:
                s+=1
            cols.append(c); t+=s; b-=s; l+=s; r-=s
        mp=dict(zip(cols,cols[::-1]))
        for y,x in cells: g[y][x]=mp[g[y][x]]
    return g

    """The connected components (8-connected) of the nonzero cells, as lists of (row, col)."""
    H, W, seen, res = len(grid), len(grid[0]), set(), []
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j] and (i, j) not in seen:
                st, cells = [(i, j)], []
                seen.add((i, j))
                while st:
                    y, x = st.pop(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                            n = (y + dy, x + dx)
                            if 0 <= n[0] < H and 0 <= n[1] < W and grid[n[0]][n[1]] and n not in seen:
                                seen.add(n); st.append(n)
                res.append(cells)
    return res

def ring_colors(grid, cells):
    """The colors of an object's nested rectangular frames, outermost to innermost, one per frame color."""
    ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
    t,b,l,r=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    cols=[]; last=None
    while t<=b and l<=r:
        c=grid[t][l]
        if c!=last: cols.append(c); last=c
        t+=1;b-=1;l+=1;r-=1
    return cols

def remap_cells(grid, cells, mapping):
    """The grid with the given cells recolored by mapping (default identity)."""
    return [[mapping.get(v,v) if (y,x) in cells else v for x,v in enumerate(row)] for y,row in enumerate(grid)]

def reverse_rings(grid):
    """Each nested-rectangle object's frame colors reversed: outermost takes the innermost color, and so on."""
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for cells in components(g):
        cols=ring_colors(grid,cells)
        mp=dict(zip(cols,cols[::-1]))
        g=remap_cells(g,cells,mp)
    return g
'''
